roadmap_item: Smart Bank Routing & Automated Real-Time Refund Tracking
reason: This is a critical retention priority as it directly addresses 68 total user reviews representing a 100.0% churn rate where users permanently switch to competitors like Paytm due to locked funds and delayed refunds exceeding a week.
success_metric: Reduce bank-timeout failure rates by 30% and automate 80% of stuck refunds to clear within T+1 day over the next 90 days.
risk: Heavy dependency on partner bank API uptime and real-time webhook responsiveness to accurately process status checks and automated reversals.

roadmap_item: Real-Time Payment Failure Fallback & Instant Provisional Reversal
reason: This theme accounts for 41 total reviews representing 2.0% of the dataset, with a critical 100.0% churn rate where affected users immediately uninstall UPI App. Customers face severe public distress and financial embarrassment at merchant POS terminals when money is debited without credit confirmation, and standard 3-5 business day support wait times drive direct user migration to competitors like PhonePe. Solving this is vital to restore trust in point-of-sale transactions and eliminate immediate churn.
success_metric: Reduce merchant payment failure dispute escalation by 50% and decrease customer churn driven by delayed refunds from 100% to under 15% within 90 days.
risk: High dependency on third-party bank APIs and NPCI switch responsiveness for real-time status reconciliation; implementing automated provisional refunds introduces short-term fraud and financial ledger reconciliation risks.

roadmap_item: Intelligent Gateway Routing & Automated UPI Lite/Server Health Recovery
reason: This theme represents a massive operational bottleneck, accounting for 1,146 total reviews (55.79% of the dataset) and a 7.24% churn rate driven by 83 churn-flagged reviews. Customer feedback highlights severe friction points such as unresolved UPI Lite failures, unexpected money deductions without instant reversal, and persistent 'Issuer bank unavailable' errors. Addressing this core reliability issue is critical to halting user churn, reducing support ticket volumes, and restoring trust in UPI App's transaction infrastructure.
success_metric: Reduce transaction failure-related support tickets by 40% and improve automatic reversal success rates for debited-yet-failed transactions to within 1 hour for 95% of cases over the next 90 days.
risk: Increased dependency on real-time health telemetry from multiple partner banks and NPCI rails, which may introduce latency overhead or require complex fallback negotiations during peak traffic hours.
theme_name: Persistent UPI Payment and Server Errors
